prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1010; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was making a left turn. Diagnosis: lumbar strain. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the soft tissue injury reported. Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, with neurological screening within normal limits. Treatment consisted of 25 visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced in line with the expected recovery pattern. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain involving the same region, which resolved completely without residual limitation before this event. Billed services reflect the treatment plan, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified in the record. At discharge the patient had met functional goals, with residual stiffness only with prolonged sitting. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise.
